reason: I'd pay 99 a month without blinking if it really took the night-time emails and posts off my plate, but 'AI co-workers' is what every tool says now. I'd start on the free plan and see if it can answer a customer email the way I would before I pay anything.
objection: I don't believe it will sound like my business or get the replies right without me checking everything, and then I'm spending my evenings babysitting a bot instead of doing the work. I also don't know how far 100 credits actually goes.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it handle a week of my real support emails and a couple of LinkedIn posts in the free trial without me rewriting them, plus a clear answer on what 100 credits actually covers.
